samples.summary: `NotesView`'s updated `showAuthors` doc names the revision preview as the mount that relies on the stored-preference fallback, but the revision preview never renders `NotesView` — it calls the engine's `initialize` directly, so the fallback now has no remaining consumer
samples.evidence: packages/frontend/src/components/history/revision-preview.tsx:759 `api = initializeNote(container, store, resolvedTheme, true, 'view')` — the note preview mounts `@wafflebase/notes` directly (import at revision-preview.tsx:20), not `NotesView`. After this change both actual `NotesView` mounts pass `showAuthors` explicitly (notes-detail.tsx:319ff and shared-notes-layout.tsx:116ff), so the `readShowAuthors()` fallback at notes-view.tsx:107-108 is unreachable and its comment describes a caller that does not exist.

samples.summary: `notes-settings.ts`'s module doc still states the shared read-only viewer does not use these preferences; the new shared layout now reads all three of them
samples.evidence: packages/frontend/src/app/notes/notes-settings.ts:6-7 "The owner editor (NotesDetail) reads them on open and writes them on change; the read-only shared viewer does not use them." — contradicted by packages/frontend/src/app/shared/shared-notes-layout.tsx:50-53, which calls `readViewMode()`, `readKeymap()` and `readShowAuthors()` on the share-link surface (including the viewer role for keymap/showAuthors).

samples.summary: `shareTokenImageUploader` (a `DocsImageUpload` that rejects on failure) is handed to the notes engine, whose `UploadImage` contract is "resolve `null`, the host already told the user" — so a failed share-link image upload is only `console.error`-ed with no toast, unlike the workspace note route
samples.evidence: packages/notes/src/view/image-upload.ts:26 defines `UploadImage = (file: File) => Promise<string | null>`, and beginUpload's `failed()` (image-upload.ts:179-190) swallows a rejection into `null` with only `console.error('Image upload failed', err)`. The workspace route satisfies the contract by catching and toasting (packages/frontend/src/app/notes/notes-detail.tsx:208-231), while the new caller passes the raw throwing docs uploader (packages/frontend/src/app/docs/image-insert.ts:40-49), so an anonymous editor's failed upload just makes the placeholder vanish silently. Fix belongs on the new code (wrap it the way `handleUploadImage` does).
